title: Kirby 5.0.0 before 5.6.4 contains a race condition in Kirby\Api\Upload::processChunk() that allows authenticated users…
description: Kirby versions 5.0.0 up to but not including 5.6.4 contain a race condition in the Kirby\Api\Upload::processChunk() function. This flaw allows authenticated users with upload permissions to bypass SVG sanitization by exploiting concurrent chunked uploads with the same filename. The vulnerability enables attackers to replace a benign SVG with a malicious script-bearing SVG, resulting in stored cross-site scripting (XSS) within the site origin.
